limitations: Actual local/peer request function prefixes ending immediately before channel allocation, with synthetic attribute iteration and device state under ASan/UBSan. Covers counts 0..513, interface/activity/required-field combinations and local channel limits. ACK accepts unrepresentable counts at this boundary; later channel validation could still reject some requests. Does not claim demonstrated memory corruption, complete netlink parsing, allocation/failure behavior, scheduling, drivers or runtime coverage.
